title: Beyond Model Weights: Sampling-Dependent Fairness in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a practical alternative to autoregressive language models (ARLMs), yet their fairness remains largely uncharacterized. DLMs introduce sampling controls with no direct autoregressive counterpart, such as block length and remasking strategy, that directly set their speed--quality operating point. This raises a basic question: does a DLM's measured social bias remain stable across these settings? Across LLaDA, LLaDA-1.5, and Dream on Open-BBQ, we find that all three models exhibit social bias, but both the magnitude of measured bias and the relative ordering of models by bias are highly sensitive to the sampling configuration. This sampling dependence also changes what successful debiasing means. While mitigation strategies established for ARLMs transfer effectively to DLMs and reduce bias without degrading downstream performance, sampling dependence persists even after mitigation. Our result

translated_title: 超越模型权重：扩散语言模型中依赖采样的公平性
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）正成为自回归语言模型（ARLM）的实用替代方案，但其公平性在很大程度上尚未得到系统表征。扩散语言模型引入了在自回归模型中没有直接对应物的采样控制参数，例如块长度和重掩码策略，这些参数直接决定了模型的速度-质量工作点。这引出一个基本问题：扩散语言模型所测得的社会偏见在这些不同设置下是否保持稳定？通过在 Open-BBQ 数据集上对 LLaDA、LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream 三个模型进行测试，我们发现这三个模型均表现出社会偏见，但所测偏见的幅度以及按偏见程度对模型进行的相对排序，都对采样配置高度敏感。这种采样依赖性也改变了“成功去偏见”的含义。虽然为自回归语言模型建立的偏见缓解策略可以有效地迁移到扩散语言模型，并在不损害下游性能的前提下减少偏见，但即使在缓解之后，采样依赖性依然存在。
tldr: 扩散语言模型的社会偏见程度及模型间的偏见排序会随采样配置（如块长度和重掩码策略）显著变化，且即使采用去偏见策略后，这种采样依赖性依然持续存在。
en_tdlr: The measured social bias in diffusion language models and the relative bias ranking across models are highly sensitive to sampling configurations, and this sampling dependence persists even after applying debiasing mitigation.
